title: Tree of Art, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Coin that brings together symbols of different art forms into one cohesive composition. Each branch leads in a different direction: music, painting, theatre, and film. Together, they form a single tree that continues to grow. Tree of Art presents creativity as something alive. The interplay of forms and colours reflects the diversity of artistic expression. It is a piece for those who see art not as decoration, but as a part of who they are.
